justification: The avatar is a grounded semi-humanoid energy Citizen. Piloting is a gated bounded-intent projection: only a `granted` control over the bound Actor turns ZQSD input into motion, clamped to max_tick_displacement per applied delta so a stalled frame cannot teleport the body. Vertical motion is withheld (axes.up=false) because the fixture Actor has no measured flight capability — an ungranted or unauthorized axis is refused, never treated as a permitted default.
